security_privacy_cost_impact: None at run time. No migration, policy, grant or role changes; nothing reachable by any role changes. The batch adds lint data, two probes, an extension of the pinned grant probe to six rules, a generator and static tests that refuse later drift: any grant or revoke for any non-superuser, non-pg_* role on any app or private table (a grant TO a predefined pg_* role is not read: README rule 7, open_blockers[185]); since the review round, any view, materialized view or foreign table in app or private, any superuser but the migration owner, and any membership among non-superuser roles (A1 R1, R2; Q0 Q-1, Q-2, Q-5); a table added without a pinned entry or a classification; a client SELECT on no allowlist or exception list (and a list row with no grant); and any client privilege on a SECRET-4, PROVIDER-3 or INTERNAL-3 TABLE (the column half is empty: README rule 17). Two drifts the draft measured passed every layer before (a table-wide client SELECT on app.workspaces; a client SELECT on app.jobs.input_ref, INTERNAL-3) and now fail migrate-clean by name, as do the reviewers' d01, d02b, d03, d04b, d05b, d06 and G18. Still passing every layer, owed on open_blockers[185]: a relation outside app and private that a non-client role reads (Q0 T02). Cost: the pinned grant probe is about 94 KB of SQL run eight times per migrate-clean (F15).
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. Batch 170's assertion-only part adds no migration and needs no migration number.
compatibility_impact: Additive. Tests stay 684 (no test added or renamed); foundation-contract's assertion floor 747 -> 788 (793 after the review round) and identity-isolation's 2166 -> 2167, the guard's own count; test floors and name digests unchanged. evidence/VERIFICATION.md leaves amends_without_owning, which moves every manifest line below it up one: the 55 WP line citations in retention-map.json, audit-coverage-map.json and the CTR-AUD-001 store-conformance fixture moved -1 and are checked; no blocker index moves (open_blockers[193] is appended at the end). Any later migration that grants, revokes or adds a table must change pinned-grants.json (regenerate with scripts/db/generate-pinned-grants.mjs and review the diff), data-classification.json and, for a client SELECT, an allowlist or exception row, in the same diff.
known_limitations: Rule 17 refuses every client privilege on a PROVIDER-3 or INTERNAL-3 table, stricter than ERD §9.1; it passes only because the twelve ERD-ambiguous tables (published_posts and performance_snapshots among them, which 120/121 record as PROVIDER-3 and expose to clients by design) are unclassified (F1, F2; Q170-d; open_blockers[193]).
The ERD classes no column, so rule 17's column half asserts nothing until it does (F3); README rule 17's heading says so since the review round (A1 R5).

The read allowlist probe reads SELECT only; client INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are held by the pinned grant probe and the permissive policy probe. RFC-2026-021 §8.2's migration-text half (create view <-> entry), the industry-catalog test's replacement and §8.3's exposed_views are not done (F7, F8; open_blockers[115]).
Rule 7 reads a column privilege a table-level one implies at table level, so a redundant column GRANT beside a table grant is named only after the table grant is revoked (F10).
Every non-superuser role is read, so on a provisioned Supabase instance the platform's own roles and default grants would read as unlisted; CI and this run use the shim's roles only (F13; Q170-c).
identity-isolation.test.mjs keeps a test name that says the registry is not in the tree; renaming it moves the name digest, the Integration Owner's to accept (F9).

The pinned grant probe does not read a grant TO a predefined pg_* role (only a role becoming one, rule 4), nor a relation outside app and private that a non-client role can read (A1 R3, Q0 Q-3; open_blockers[185]).

"Inherited" in the §8.5 list is a reading: 10 of its 41 rows come from 010/020/021, which §8.5 names, and 31 from 13 later migrations; closing at 41 accepts the 31, put to A1 and the Owner with Q170-b (C0 F1, A1 R4; open_blockers[18]).

scripts/db/generate-pinned-grants.mjs is a reviewer's tool, not a gate: nothing in make, npm, the tests or CI runs it (C0 F7, Q0 Q-6; open_blockers[193] (11)).
